name: Ngo Chi Dung
forbes_bio: Ngo Chi Dung is the chairman of VPBank, also known as Vietnam Prosperity Bank, one of the largest banks in Vietnam.
The banking veteran served as vice chairman of rival Techcombank before joining VPBank in 2010.
In 2021, VPBank sold a 49% stake in its consumer finance unit FE Credit to Japan's  Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group for $1.4 billion.
He holds a doctoral degree in economics from the Institute of Socio-Political Research under Russian Academy of Sciences.
VPBank Securities, the bank's brokerage arm, went public in Ho Chi Minh City in 2025.

name: Bimal Kumar Gyanchandani
forbes_bio: Low profile brothers Murli Dhar and Bimal Gyanchandani control family's Kanpur-headquartered consumer goods firm RSPL Group.
RSPL is best known for its low-cost Ghari detergent, which is popular in north India.
Murli Dhar's two sons work in the group, along with Bimal's son Rohit, after whom the flagship Rohit Surfactants is named.
The brothers' other interests include real estate and footwear under the Red Chief brand.
forbes_facts: The siblings have set up a charitable hospital in Kanpur named after their parents.

name: Pan Longquan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023); Hurun Global (2022-2023); Hurun China (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Pan Longquan is the chairman and co-founder of Chervon, a supplier of power tools such as saws and drills, as well as outdoor power equipment such as riding mowers and snow blowers.
Customers of the Nanjing-headquartered company include Lowe's and Kingfisher.
Cornerstone investors in Chervon's IPO include an investment company owned by Chinese billionaire Liu Jincheng, the chairman of lithium battery supplier EVE Energy, and his wife Luo Jinhong.

name: Beyoncé Knowles-Carter
forbes_bio: The majority of pop star Beyoncé Knowles' net worth comes from her roughly three decades as a solo performer and a member of the girl-group Destiny's Child.
Beyoncé holds the record for the most Grammy wins ever, with 35, adding three more including her first Album of the Year trophy in February 2025.
Beyoncé released her eighth solo album, "Cowboy Carter," in March 2024, and in April 2025 began a world tour with the same name.
She and Jay-Z reportedly purchased a $200 million Malibu mansion in May 2023, the most expensive home ever sold in California.
She performed at halftime of the first ever Netflix Christmas Day NFL game in 2025, nearly a dozen years after headlining the Super Bowl Halftime Show in 2013.
forbes_facts: Beyonce was the first black woman to headline music festival Coachella in 2018; at the time, her performance was the most-streamed Coachella video on YouTube ever.
Her husband Jay-Z is also a billionaire, thanks to a variety of investments in music, art and liquor.

name: Wilbur 'Ed' Bosarge Jr
forbes_bio: Math whiz worked for IBM on NASA's Saturn rockets in the 1960s.
Founded pioneering high-speed-trading outfit Quantlab, which at one point moved 3% of volumes on the NYSE.
According to court documents, Quantlab generated more than $2 billion in net profits over the past 15 years. Ed's 72% stake is held via trusts.
Bosarge is the beneficiary of trusts, domiciled in South Dakota, that according to court filings hold assets of more than $1 billion.
A proponent of stem cell therapies, Bosarge sponsored a symposium at the Vatican, after which the church came out in favor of research on adult stem cells.
forbes_facts: Over Yonder Cay, his 72-acre private island in the Bahamas, runs entirely on renewable energy.

name: Tory Burch
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2013-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Fashion mogul Tory Burch's clothing and lifestyle brand sold an estimated $1.8 billion worth of clothing, shoes, accessories and fragrances in 2024.
Now boasting more than 370 locations around the world, the company is currently focused on expanding its presence in Asia.
In 2019, Burch became executive chairman and chief creative officer of the fashion company that bears her name.
Pierre-Yves Roussel, a former LVMH executive and Burch's husband, took over the CEO position.
The art history grad worked for designers Ralph Lauren and Vera Wang before opening a boutique in New York City's Nolita neighborhood in 2004.
forbes_facts: Her popular ballet flats, which come in every conceivable color, are named the Reva after her mother.
Burch came up with 10 different names for her brand before deciding to use her own name.

name: Robert Steers
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2025); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Robert Steers cofounded investment management firm Cohen & Steers in 1986 and took the company public in 2004.
Steers served as a co-CEO until 2022 and is now the company's executive chairman.
Steers remains the company's largest shareholder with a 23% stake.
Before striking out on his own, Steers worked as an analyst and portfolio manager for Citibank's Emerging Growth Stock Fund from 1977 to 1982.
In 1985, Steers and his future cofounder Martin Cohen helped launch the first real estate securities mutual fund in the U.S. at the National Securities and Research Corporation.

name: Wang Qinghua
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2021-2022); Hurun Global (2021-2022); Hurun China (2020-2022)
forbes_bio: Wang Qinghua chairs Bafang Electric, a supplier of motors for electric bikes.
Bafang went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2019.
